promises.holds: A life made with the guide starts paused (src/engine/world/bootstrap.ts:359); Play is Locked and world.set_preferences refused until “The Clock”, which opens both (src/engine/content/tutorial.ts:175).

promises.claim: A place joins the menu once you’ve read its chapter.
promises.holds: The rail lists a place only once its chapter is read (`railGroups`, src/ui/shell/GameShell.tsx:50).

promises.claim: Go There on a notice takes you to its screen, and to its tab where the notice names one.
promises.holds: Go There goes to the notice’s own route (src/ui/screens/Home.tsx:257, src/ui/screens/Updates.tsx:158), and the provider opens the screen at the tab a route names (`?tab=`, src/app/game-context.tsx:262), else where it was left. Until 2026-10-21 the promise said “its screen and tab”, though most notices name only their screen.

promises.claim: Each payment the contract promised is paid on its payday, and its state says where it stands.
promises.holds: Each promised payment is on the clock for its payday (`schedulePay`, src/engine/systems/propay.ts) and its state is read from the record and the clock (`payState`, src/engine/systems/contracts.ts:267).

promises.claim: Accepting an offer makes its contract.
promises.holds: pro.accept_offer writes the engagement's contract (`contractFor`, src/engine/systems/contracts.ts), as an option taken up does the next season's.

promises.claim: A further episode or an option taken up past SAG-AFTRA’s thirty days needs you to be a member.
promises.holds: The season's refusal reads `sagWorkRefusal` for a further episode's days and an option's (src/engine/systems/projobs.ts, SEASON_HOOKS.refusal), so a non-member past the thirtieth day isn't called and the option lapses with why.

promises.claim: The agreements’ rules for a dub, a stunt, an intimate scene and a recall to loop are in the contract.
promises.holds: The contract's clauses end on the workflow's rules (`workflowRules`, src/engine/systems/contracts.ts:229), read from the part's format, its dub, its stunts, its intimate scene and whether it can be recalled to loop.

promises.claim: A looping session is paid half a day, on the work’s pay.
promises.holds: The session worked puts half the contract's day rate (`loopPay`, src/engine/systems/workflow.ts:631) among the engagement's payments, due the Thursday after, and puts it on the clock (`schedulePay`, src/engine/systems/workflow.ts:673).

promises.claim: How a part’s days were judged, and its scenes kept in the edit, are what its entry reads.
promises.holds: The entry's eligibility counts the scenes kept, cut ones out (`emmyCheck`, src/engine/systems/awards.ts), and the field's standing for the player reads the credit's band, the best of its days (`fieldFor`).

promises.claim: Recognition makes casting likelier to choose you for a while.
promises.holds: Casting's decision passes the player's visibility to its draw (src/engine/systems/projobs.ts:2563), which lifts the chance within casting's ceiling (`castingDraw`), fading over three years (`visibilityOf`).

promises.claim: A role’s Open Its Page opens its project here, and the project’s page sends you back to answer it.
promises.holds: RoleFacts' Open Its Page calls openReference with the part's projectKey (src/ui/career/OpportunitiesPane.tsx, src/ui/career/ReferencePane.tsx), and a project's page offers Open Opportunities while its posting is open, submitted, auditioning, called back or offered (`actionsFor`, src/engine/systems/reference.ts).

promises.claim: A credit’s page lists its award entries, and sends you to Charts And Awards to enter or go.
promises.holds: A project's page lists each award and festival entry of its credits in the Charts And Awards tab's own words (`honorFacts`), and offers Open Charts And Awards for a credit on screen (`actionsFor`, src/engine/systems/reference.ts).
